subject: Re: Streaming responses ending early (request IDs) - BluePeak Analytics
body:
From: Nina Sorensen <nina@bluepeakanalytics.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 13, 2025 at 09:22
Subject: Streaming responses ending early (request IDs)

Hi Aisha,

Were seeing intermittent cases where streaming responses end early on the OpenAI-compatible API. The connection closes without the final [DONE] event, leaving us with truncated output.

This started in the last ~24h and seems worse in EU. Were calling /v1/chat/completions with stream=true.

A couple request IDs: req_f3a8XXXX (2025-02-13 08:57 UTC), req_c11dXXXX (2025-02-13 09:05 UTC).

Is this a known issue?

Thanks,
Nina

---
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nina Sorensen <nina@bluepeakanalytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 13, 2025 at 10:03
Subject: Re: Streaming responses ending early (request IDs)

Thanks Nina  were investigating similar reports. Ive opened SUP-2490 for tracking and looped in an engineer.

Quick questions:
- Are you using the OpenAI Python SDK or a custom SSE client?
- Are you behind any proxy that could enforce idle/read timeouts?

In the meantime, please log cases where you dont receive [DONE] along with x-request-id.

Best,
Aisha
Customer Support
Redwood Inference

---
From: Ravi Menon <ravi@bluepeakanalytics.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 13, 2025 at 13:19
Subject: Re: Streaming responses ending early (request IDs)

Were using the OpenAI Python SDK, no proxy (direct from our backend). We do have a load balancer but it has a 120s idle timeout, and these fail in <30s.

---
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ravi Menon <ravi@bluepeakanalytics.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 13, 2025 at 17:41
Subject: Re: Streaming responses ending early (request IDs)

Thanks  we found a likely cause where the OpenAI-compat streaming route can go quiet long enough that a gateway read timeout closes the connection, which looks like truncated SSE.

Were rolling out a mitigation (periodic SSE heartbeat comments) in eu-west first. Well update SUP-2490 and email you when its live.

Dev
Serving Runtime
